_doc: Transactions for the transfer classification tests (PLAN WP-08 item 3; src/classify/tests.rs). `txs`: other signers' transactions found on 2026-10-04 by scanning public mainnet blocks (slots 453,330,484-453,330,549) for CPI tips, wraps, unwraps, PumpSwap creator fees and Glaive tips; fetched into testdata/classify/<sig>.json by `tools/capture-fixtures.py --classify`. `wallet`: the two of our wallet's transactions the tests use (testdata/wallet/, fetched by --wallet).

txs.what: legacy; a program pays Jito 202,846 lamports from inside (System transfer at stack height 2); a vault program refunds the signer at height 3

v0 with lookup tables; an arbitrage program's Jupiter route sells on PumpSwap three levels down (protocol, creator and buyback fees from the pool's quote vault), then its vault pays Jito 6,255 lamports by CPI
v0; a top-level PumpSwap buy: two ATAs created, 239,868,095 lamports wrapped (transfer + SyncNative), protocol / creator / buyback fees, the WSOL ATA closed back to the signer
v0, failed (InstructionError 4 custom 0), durable nonce; a top-level Glaive tip of 30,036,343 lamports
v1 (SIMD-0385), failed (InstructionError 2 custom 1); a top-level Glaive tip

wallet.what: our w5h2/w5h3 win: a Jito bundle (top-level tip 7,254 lamports) whose PumpSwap buy_exact_quote_in leg inside our program pays the coin creator 396,412 lamports
the wallet's setup: WSOL ATA created, 4.2 SOL wrapped
